title: Blood Pressure value page: after the systolic auto-advance, the diastolic focus ring is drawn outside the box, covers the gaps to "/" and "mmHg", and is black in WebKit, not the teal accent
evidence: Caused by PR 1508 (H71). After systolic auto-advances to diastolic, the diastolic box's focus ring sits outside the box (outline-offset) and covers the gaps to the "/" and "mmHg" labels. In real WebKit it is black, not the teal accent. Fix idea: an inset ring in teal. First among the PR 1508 design leads. (H78)
